sc: An Ammonite Necklace token is an item that was originally available from The Beach (2021) event.
It could also be bought from the New Item Shop.
It is created by combining an Amulet of Offerings with a Latent Offering and various other items, starting with 1,000 charges after being crafted.
Ancient pages are items which are sometimes obtained when rummaging barbarian skeletons or as monster drops in the Ancient Cavern.
Duplicate pages may still be obtained before completion of My notes if rummaging skeletons.
Ancient page 4 is an item which can be added to the damaged Zaros book received from Jossik after the Horror from the Deep quest.
It can be found as a reward from all difficulties of Treasure Trails or by burning vyre corpses in the columbarium.
Attack XP lamp is a possible reward from the Observatory Quest.
An augmented Armadyl godsword is a level 75 melee two-handed weapon created by using an augmentor on an Armadyl godsword.
Additionally, it can be made by dyeing an undyed version or upgrading a non-elite version.

The blood-dyed augmented Khopesh of Elidinis is a level 92 Melee off-hand weapon, created by using an augmentor on a Khopesh of Elidinis (blood), or by using blood dye on an augmented Khopesh of Elidinis.
The augmented Second-Age robe top is a tier 80 Magic torso slot tank armour, requiring 80 Defence to equip, created by using an augmentor on a Second-Age robe top.
It was re-obtainable from Isak if you had left the area after obtaining it.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 8 necronium bars and a necronium full helm + 2, requiring 1,920 progress to complete, granting a total of 4,000 Smithing experience.
It is made by lighting a bullseye lantern (oil), which requires 49 Firemaking.
Lit bullseye lanterns may be directly obtained from the Lorehound pet, requiring 50 quest points to be assigned to the pet track of May's Quest Caravan to make use of the fetch supplies ability.
Chemical powder was an item obtained by using the Chest key (The Dig Site) to open the chest near the panning point.
It is obtained by using a dramen branch with a pestle and mortar.
Although there is indeed a cinnamon tree in the game, it cannot be used to obtain cinnamon; it must come from the dramen tree.
They are obtained upon opening a sealed clue scroll (easy).
Easy clue scroll rewards range from as few as 100 coins to over 1,000,000 coins if certain rare rewards are obtained, due to the high demand for Fortunate components they Disassemble into.
Clue scroll (easy) is an emote clue obtained from easy sealed clue scrolls.
Once one shard per skill has been obtained, players can combine them to create a Combatant's hood, and a matching expert skillcape.
It can be obtained for free from the Competitive Group Ironman armour stand on the Iron Enclave by players who formed a competitive group in the Group Ironman Mode.
The Corrupted Combust cosmetic ability scroll is an item that can be obtained from the Academy of Heroes promotion on Treasure Hunter.

sc: During the quest One Small Favour, it is obtained by talking to Tindel Marchant in Port Khazard.

Kebbit teeth dust is obtained by grinding Kebbit teeth, obtained by deadfalling a Sabre-toothed kebbit at level 51 Hunter, with a pestle and mortar, awarding the player with 1 Herblore experience.
The dust is a secondary ingredient for the Hunter potion, which can be created at level 53 Herblore.
The key to the Crossing is a drop that is obtained from defeating the inhabitants of the Sophanem Slayer Dungeon, the Sanctum of Rebirth and Amascut, the Devourer.

The base drop chance of a key is 1/400, which is increased to 1/75 when on-task, and 1/128 as a "refund" drop from the Magister himself; these are increased to 1/395, 1/60, and 1/100 respectively when carrying a Sophanem slayer dungeon drop enhancer.

sc: It can be purchased for 99,000 coins (or 92,000 coins with the ring of charos (a) or its imbued version) alongside the Runecrafting hood from Larriar at the Runecrafting Guild by players who have achieved level 99 Runecrafting.

Before the introduction of the Runespan, the Runecrafting cape was one of the most difficult capes to obtain because training Runecrafting required large amounts of time, effort and dedication to level.
Ruby bolt tips are bolt tips created by crafting rubies at level 63 Fletching, creating 12 bolt tips per ruby.
They can be made at a forge and anvil using 4 rune bars and rune claws + 1, requiring 1,200 progress to complete, granting a total of 960 Smithing experience.
Rune dust is an item obtained by siphoning a runesphere in the Runespan.
The platebody requires 50 Defence to wear and cannot be made using the Smithing skill.
Players can obtain a rune platebody (Saradomin) as a reward from completing hard Treasure Trails or burning vyre corpses in the Columbarium.
They were obtainable to attendees who redeemed a code through Diango.
It is also available as an override for RuneFest 2013 attendees.
The cape, like the Runefest 2011 hood, did not need to be redeemed at RuneFest 2013 and can be redeemed anywhere.
It can be purchased from the Daemonheim Rewards shop for 60,000 Dungeoneering tokens.

sc: To obtain the key the player must first go to the Goblin Cave and turn into a goblin using a goblin potion.

The player must then wear white goblin mail in order to be able to access the Saragorgak goblin tribe's area in the cave, and can then pickpocket the Saragorgak priest to obtain the Saragorgak key required to continue the quest.

This item can be created with the assist from another Player if lacking the required Crafting level.

It has tier 50 stats, and is obtained by upgrading the tier 40 variant after the completion of Kili's Knowledge III.
